messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

This can let metformin build up in your body.
Your doctor may have you stop taking metformin around the time of the test.
Your doctor may have you restart metformin once your kidney function is confirmed to be back to normal.

The relation 'temporarily affects' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject substance has a temporary impact on the function or state of the specified entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

A. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
C. 'reduces': The subject drug decreases or lessens the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
